claims.claim_text: Regular Design Services are organized into six phases.

source_support.source_label: UAP SPP Document 202 - Regular Design Services
source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: SPP 202 lists the six phases of Regular Design Services.

claims.claim_text: The compiled SPP describes regular design phase tasks.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: The compiled SPP describes SPPCC, design development, contract documents, bidding, and construction phase duties.

claims.claim_text: Regular Design Service compensation may use percentage of PCC and other methods.

source_support.locator: UAP Standards of Professional Practice refined markdown lines 414-457

source_support.locator: UAP Standards of Professional Practice refined markdown lines 578-586

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: The Code requires stating services and charges and charging a commensurate professional fee.
